name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Momentum & Aerial Breakers
archetype: Special Grass/Flying starter pivot, quad-Flying STAB wallbreaker, and rapid Psychic offensive sweeper.
gym_duel_rationale: Erika enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Enter with Venusaur/Fearow (500 BST Grass/Flying powerhouse quad-resisting Grass with STAB Drill Peck hitting Tangela/Primeape for 4x damage and Roost recovery), Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST breaker with Vital Spirit sleep immunity, Cross Chop, and Magnitude), and Arcanine/Gloom (Fire/Poison quad-resisting Grass with Flamethrower and Extreme Speed).

roster.progression_notes: Venusaur splices with Fearow. 500 BST with 93 Speed. Quad-resists Grass and immune to Ground. STAB Drill Peck inflicts 4x quad-effective damage on Tangela/Primeape with Roost recovery.
457 BST physical fortress with 101 Attack and 93 Defense. Vital Spirit completely immunizes it against Erika's Sleep Powder and Hypnosis.
Growlithe (Fire Stone) and Gloom (Leaf Stone) stone-evolved and spliced. Quad-resists Grass while retaliating with STAB Flamethrower and Extreme Speed priority.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Celadon Sewers Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Combines Kadabra's 108 Special Attack with Weezing's Levitate ground immunity and 90 Defense. STAB Psychic cleanly dismantles Erika's Poison-type hybrids while Levitate provides complete Ground immunity.

roster.status: Active in Party (Celadon Stone & Diglett Splice)
roster.role: Fast Water Absorb Sweeper & Ground Bruiser
roster.progression_notes: Poliwhirl evolved with Water Stone and spliced with Dugtrio. 483 BST with 103 Speed and 98 Attack. Water Absorb counters Water while Earthquake deals heavy damage.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for wild catches with Compound Eyes 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Rock Tunnel splice combining Marowak with Aron. 103 Base Defense wall.

active_fusions: Venusaur/Fearow (500 BST Grass/Flying starter with 4x STAB Drill Peck and Roost)
Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST Vital Spirit sleep-immune physical breaker)
Arcanine/Gloom (Fire/Poison quad-resisting Grass with Flamethrower and Extreme Speed)
Kadabra/Weezing (108 SpA Levitate Psychic/Poison special sweeper with 90 Defense)
Poliwrath/Dugtrio (483 BST Water Absorb fast ground sweeper with 103 Speed)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Celadon Poké Mart: Pay $300 to unfuse Ivysaur/Dugtrio from Chapter 3.
2. Level Ivysaur to Lv. 32 to evolve into Venusaur.
3. Splice Venusaur with Fearow for 4x STAB Drill Peck on Tangela/Primeape and Roost.
4. Purchase Fire and Leaf Stones at Celadon Dept Store 4F to evolve Growlithe and Gloom into Arcanine/Gloom.
5. Catch Koffing in Celadon Sewers, evolve at Lv. 35 to Weezing, and splice with Kadabra for Levitate Ground immunity.
upcoming_fusions: Venusaur/Alakazam (Psychic Grass titan with Linking Cord)
